title: Maximum Sum of Non-Adjacent Elements
description: Given an array of integers, select a subset of elements such that no two chosen elements are adjacent in the original array and the sum of the chosen elements is maximized. You may also choose no elements, resulting in a sum of 0. Return the maximum possible sum.
InputFormat:
Line 1: n (array length)
Line 2: n space-separated integers (the array)
referenceSolution:
import sys

def solve(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    prev2 = 0
    prev1 = max(0, arr[0])
    for i in range(1, n):
        current = max(prev1, prev2 + arr[i])
        prev2 = prev1
        prev1 = current
    return prev1

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(data[0])
arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
print(solve(arr))

examples.explanation: Choosing elements 1, 3 and 5 gives the maximum sum 1+3+5=9.
All numbers are negative, so selecting no element yields sum 0.
